5 تقمّرهُ He came to him in the moonlight. (S.) ―
-b2- تقمّر الظِّبَآءَ, (A, TA,) and الطَّيْرَ, (TA,) He hunted, or pursued, the antelopes, (A, TA,) and the birds, (TA,) in the moonlight, so that their sight was dazzled. (A, TA.) ―
-b3- تقمّر الأَسَدُ The lion went forth in the moonlight in quest of prey. (S, K. *) ＝
-A2- تقمّرهُ He deceived, beguiled, or circumvented, him; desired to do him some evil action without his knowing whence it proceeded. (A.) ＝
-A3- See also 3, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
